summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), added 14 tests to tests/test_progress.py before the script-entry block, added two subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added one Added entry to CHANGELOG.md. Changes are insertions only and nothing is committed. Tests and code were not run, per instructions, so verification is by reading only. Choices: extra str fallback overloads on both open entry points; readinto is looked up with getattr because BinaryIO does not declare it; 'tr' returns a binary reader as the spec states; Progress.open can leave a task behind if the file open fails after the task is created, following the spec's step order.
